description: Implementation of the AmbiorixDummy class with various set, read_param, add_instance, remove_instance, and other methods related to the nbapi namespace in the beerocks project.

classes.name: AmbiorixDummy
classes.description: A dummy implementation class for nbapi operations, providing stub methods that always return true or default values.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a parameter value identified by relative path and parameter name, overloaded for various data types.

methods.name: read_param
methods.description: Reads a parameter value into the provided pointer, overloaded for various data types.

methods.name: add_instance
methods.description: Adds a new instance at the specified relative path, returns an empty string.

methods.name: remove_instance
methods.description: Removes an instance at the specified relative path and index.

methods.name: get_instance_index
methods.description: Returns the index of an instance based on specific path and key, always returns 0.

methods.name: get_datamodel_time_format
methods.description: Returns the data model time format as an empty string.

methods.name: remove_all_instances
methods.description: Removes all instances at the specified relative path.

methods.name: add_optional_subobject
methods.description: Adds an optional subobject at the specified path.

methods.name: remove_optional_subobject
methods.description: Removes an optional subobject at the specified path.

methods.name: set_current_time
methods.description: Sets the current time for the specified object path.

methods.name: set_time
methods.description: Sets a timestamp for the specified object path.
